description.value: Minerva's has been a family-owned landmark in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood since 1975, serving hand-pressed pizzas, charbroiled steaks, hearty pastas, and traditional Greek dishes. The restaurant features a cozy dining room alongside a lounge and patio with happy hour specials, and supports takeout and delivery for those on the go. Its central west-side location makes it a potential refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the Arbutus Greenway corridor or the broader neighbourhood.
